name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: call_id
description: UUID of this LLM call, assigned by the gateway.

name: run_id
description: Run that made the call (invariant 6).

name: step_index
description: Step within the run that made the call.

name: agent
description: Agent that made the call; cost is attributed to it.

name: provider
description: LLM provider as reported by LiteLLM.

name: model
description: Exact model ID that answered.

name: is_fallback
description: True when the primary model failed and the fallback model answered.

name: prompt
description: Messages sent, exactly as logged by the gateway. Schema metadata only, never user row values (ADR-004).

name: response
description: Model response as logged by the gateway; null if the call failed.

name: tool_calls
description: Tool calls the model requested, before the policy gate checked them.

name: input_tokens
description: Prompt tokens billed.

name: output_tokens
description: Completion tokens billed.

name: cost_usd
description: Cost of this call in USD, from the gateway's pricing table.

name: latency_ms
description: Time from request to complete response.

name: status
description: ok, error, or refused_budget when the monthly cap blocked the call (TM-11).

name: error_code
description: Provider or gateway error code when status is not ok.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
